title: GitHub Copilot Review (2026)
intro: GitHub Copilot is evaluated here as AI software — GitHub Copilot is GitHub’s AI coding assistant for completions, Copilot Chat, and coding agents inside VS Code, JetBrains, and github.com. Distinct from Microsoft 365 Copilot and from GitHub the source-control platform. Published seats: Copilot Pro $10/mo, Pro+ $39, Max $100, Business $19/user/mo, Enterprise $39/user/mo. From 1 June 2026 plans include monthly GitHub AI Credits with $0.01/credit overage. Completions on paid plans remain unlimited in GitHub’s billing docs. This review uses SoftwareGlimpse’s AI methodology (ease of use, AI job fit, output quality, workflow depth, integrations, governance/privacy, scalability, value, model capability), scoring products inside their job cluster rather than against unrelated peers. It is based on first-party research, not hands-on lab testing.
summary: Choose GitHub Copilot when AI coding inside GitHub and your current IDE is the job — not Microsoft 365 Copilot.
verdict: Choose GitHub Copilot when AI coding inside GitHub and your current IDE is the job — not Microsoft 365 Copilot. Compare Cursor for an AI-native editor; ChatGPT if you only need general coding chat. Scores reflect first-party documentation as of 2026-08-18 — not hands-on product testing. Confirm current packaging, usage caps and credit rates on the vendor site before purchase.

criterionAssessments.rationale: Installs into VS Code/JetBrains/github.com with little new surface — strong for GitHub-native teams.
Primary job is AI coding assistant — ranked in ai-code with Cursor, not as an LLM-assistant peer of ChatGPT.
Completions and chat quality track GitHub’s model catalog; not a hands-on bake-off vs Cursor.
PR, repo, and cloud-agent workflows add depth beyond autocomplete; held at 8 vs AI-native IDEs.
Native GitHub + IDE plugins is the distribution advantage.
Business/Enterprise publish org policy and admin; consumer Pro is weaker.
Free/Pro through Business/Enterprise is a clear org ladder.
$10 Pro is a low individual floor; credit overage is the TCO risk. Affiliate economics excluded.
Broad model catalog on paid plans; not claimed as the single highest-compute IDE.

bestFor: Teams already on GitHub who want IDE + PR Copilot

Developers who want completions without switching editors
notIdealFor: Buyers whose job is Microsoft 365 drafting (M365 Copilot)
Developers standardised on an AI-native editor (Cursor)
pros: Lives in GitHub and major IDEs
Unlimited completions on paid plans (per GitHub billing docs)
cons: AI Credit overage after included pool
Enterprise SKU tied to GitHub Enterprise Cloud

Easy to confuse with Microsoft 365 Copilot in procurement
keyFeatures: Copilot Chat in IDE and github.com
limitations: Not Microsoft 365 Copilot — no Word/Excel Graph assistant
Usage-based AI Credits can exceed the $10/$19 sticker after included pool
Deepest Enterprise features need GitHub Enterprise Cloud
Weaker as a standalone research chat than ChatGPT/Perplexity
